name: homelab-admin
description: Claude Code as the administrator of a home server: a coordinator with sub-agents, rules with their reasons, procedure skills, guard hooks and a sentinel that wakes the session on a monitor Down.

owner_language.title: Owner's language
owner_language.description: Language of the messages the agents send to the owner's channel (e.g. English, Italiano).

delegate_pattern.title: Delegation pattern
delegate_pattern.description: Extended regex of commands that are agent work, not coordinator work.

delegate_agents.title: Agents for that work
delegate_agents.description: Agent names the delegation reminder suggests.

model_limit.title: Model weight limit
model_limit.description: The memory rule for the ollama host, shown before a model is pulled or run.
model_limit.default: keep models under 60% of the free RAM of the ollama host

status_script.title: Project status script
status_script.description: Absolute path of your own status script, e.g. /opt/homelab/status.sh, owned by root and not writable by others: it runs with sudo (see SECURITY.md). A relative path, or a script or folder others can edit, is refused. When set, status.sh runs it instead of its own checks; it must accept --busy (exit 1 if something is working). Empty: the built-in checks.
